recognize_zh: 淋巴結免疫染色（棕色）中，散在的大型細胞呈清楚的環狀膜染色，細胞核大而淡、形狀不規則，周圍是大量陰性的小淋巴球；這種「大型 B 細胞散在於小淋巴球背景」的分佈符合 NLPHL 的 LP 細胞（lymphocyte predominant cells）。
features: Scattered large cells with strong circumferential membranous and cytoplasmic staining (DAB)
Large positive cells have large pale vesicular, irregular or lobated nuclei
Some smaller positive cells, focally clustered at the lower right edge
Background of numerous small round unstained lymphocytes
No sheet-like confluence of large positive cells in this field
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (chromogen DAB; antigen not labeled, pattern suggests a B-cell marker such as CD20) of a lymph node shows numerous scattered large cells with strong membranous staining set in a background of predominantly negative small lymphocytes. The large cells have irregular, vesicular nuclei. Smaller positive cells are present focally. The pattern of scattered large B cells within a small-lymphocyte background is consistent with LP cells of nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma with a variant (T-cell-rich/extranodular) pattern; the antigen and full architecture should be confirmed in the referenced case.

ddx.vs: THRLBCL shows diffuse architecture without residual follicular dendritic cell meshworks or small B-cell-rich nodules, whereas NLPHL retains nodular CD21+ meshworks with small B cells.
HRS cells of cHL are CD30+/CD15+ with weak or absent CD20 and PAX5 dim, while LP cells are strongly CD20+, OCT2+, BOB1+ and CD30/CD15 negative.
PTGC lacks LP cells; scattered large atypical CD20+ cells rimmed by PD1+ T cells favor NLPHL.
